title.zh: Israel Extradites Alleged Nomad Bridge Exploiter to US Over $2.8M Theft: Report
title.en: Israel Extradites Alleged Nomad Bridge Exploiter to US Over $2.8M Theft: Report

current_state.zh: Israel extradited Alexander Block to the U.S. to face charges over the alleged $2.8 million Nomad bridge theft, after Israel's Supreme Court rejected his appeal and upheld that exploiting a software flaw can be unlawful computer intrusion.
current_state.en: Israel extradited Alexander Block to the U.S. to face charges over the alleged $2.8 million Nomad bridge theft, after Israel's Supreme Court rejected his appeal and upheld that exploiting a software flaw can be unlawful computer intrusion.
